As Nam Tai Ppty (NTP) Stock Price Rose, Holder Kahn Brothers Group Trimmed Its Holding; Celgene (CELG) Holder Maryland Capital Management Has Lifted Its Stake by $1.22 Million as Stock Value Declined
May 25, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Maryland Capital Management increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 13.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management bought 11,752 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 95,949 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.01 million, up from 84,197 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $57.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.85% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $78.86. About 1.46 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Irving Kahn decreased its stake in Nam Tai Ppty (NTP) by 6.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kahn Brothers Group Inc sold 123,805 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.67% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Irving Kahn held 1.86M shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $23.28B, down from 1.98M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kahn Brothers Group Inc who had been investing in Nam Tai Ppty for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $454.67M market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $12.1. About 1,675 shares traded. Nam Tai Property Inc. (NYSE:NTP) has risen 78.87% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 67.32% the S&P500.
Kahn Brothers Group Inc, which manages about $636.58 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Idw Media by 48 shares to 78,578 shares, valued at $3.61 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Genie Energy by 333 shares in the quarter, for a total of 406,052 shares, and has risen its stake in Bank Of America (NYSE:BAC).
Maryland Capital Management, which manages about $795.96 million and $675.52M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4,001 shares to 151,887 shares, valued at $25.70 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Amazon Com Inc Com (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 656 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 18,669 shares, and cut its stake in Conocophillips (NYSE:COP).
